positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Worked on the Data Pipelines team which manages the Kafka infrastructure and background jobs for GitHub.

- Built a custom load testing service in Java to simulate production workloads on a high-throughput low-latency job queueing service (4 billion background jobs/day). Immediate impact with Kafka upgrade validation (2.6 to 3.9), used to test the next design evolution towards 10x scalability.
- Developed CLI tooling in Go to reduce the number of steps to synchronize configurations between job queue service clusters by 80%, reducing time to configure new clusters.
- Improved concurrency throttling for distributed job queue service processing time quota algorithm during peak hours.
- Actively on-call for a team that manages 20+ Kafka clusters with 99.999% reliability processing 360k msgs/sec during peak traffic.
positions.insights: Skills: Go · Java · Ruby · Apache Kafka · Kubernetes · Datadog · Splunk

positions.title: Senior Cloud Native Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer in the Onica professional services group delivering cloud native AWS applications.

- Led the migration of an AWS IoT Greengrass V1 solution to V2 while maintaining data flow and integrations with an existing customer portal.
- Built a serverless translations service in TypeScript with a React frontend that automated the submission and receipt of translations from a third-party, reducing developer workload by over 70%. Created a CI/CD pipeline using CDK that automated the retrieval, parsing, and submission of documents to the translations service.
- Delivered a serverless API in TypeScript that automated the provisioning of VMs and AWS Workspaces.

positions.title: Cyber Algorithm Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Software engineer with a focus on setting up a new team developing tools for defensive cyber operations using Scala and Python.

- Technical lead for cyber analytics that integrated with a big data platform using Apache Spark.
- Orchestrated the setup of development processes, environments, and tools for a team of six engineers.
